Standardize differential expression results

Source: R/de_tables.R
standardize_de.Rd

Reads DE results from edgeR, DESeq2, limma or Seurat (or any table, with the columns given explicitly) into one table with standard column names, so that every DE plot of the package reads them the same way.

Usage

standardize_de(
  data,
  method = c("auto", "edgeR", "DESeq2", "limma", "seurat"),
  feature.col = NULL,
  logfc.col = NULL,
  p.col = NULL,
  padj.col = NULL,
  mean.col = NULL,
  comparison.col = NULL,
  groups = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame of DE results (or an object coercible to one, such as a DESeq2 `DESeqResults` or edgeR `TopTags`); or a named list of them, one per comparison, the names becoming the `comparison` column

method

The tool that produced the results: "auto" (default) detects it from the column names and says which was picked; or one of "edgeR", "DESeq2", "limma" and "seurat"

feature.col

Column of feature (gene) names. If NULL (default), the `gene` column of Seurat results when there is one (as from FindAllMarkers()), else the row names

logfc.col, p.col, padj.col, mean.col

Columns of the log2 fold change, raw p-value, adjusted p-value and mean expression. Each NULL (default) is taken from `method`. Give e.g. the column of a shrunken log fold change (DESeq2 lfcShrink(), apeglm) as `logfc.col`

comparison.col

For a single table holding several comparisons, the column naming the comparison of each row (e.g. "cluster" for FindAllMarkers()). Default is NULL

groups

Optional second level of comparisons, used for brackets in multi-comparison plots: a data frame with `comparison` and `group` columns, or a character vector of groups named by comparison

Value

A data frame with the columns `feature`, `logfc`, `pvalue`, `padj`, `mean_expr` (when available), `comparison` and `group` (when given), then the other columns of the input. Attributes `method` (one per comparison) and `mean.scale` ("log2" or "linear", NA when unknown) record how it was read

Details

Columns read for each method:

methodlogfcpvaluepadjmean_expr
edgeRlogFCPValueFDRlogCPM (log2)
DESeq2log2FoldChangepvaluepadjbaseMean (linear)
limmalogFCP.Valueadj.P.ValAveExpr (log2)
seuratavg_log2FCp_valp_val_adjnone

When there is no adjusted p-value column, adjusted p-values are computed with the Benjamini-Hochberg method, per comparison, with a message.

p-values of exactly 0, which come from numerical underflow, are replaced by the smallest non-zero p-value of the table times 0.1, with a message, so that they are drawn just beyond the other points rather than at an arbitrary 1e-300. NA p-values (e.g. from DESeq2's independent filtering) are kept and reported; plots treat them as not significant.

Seurat versions before 4 reported natural-log fold changes (`avg_logFC`); these are not read automatically, since mixing them with log2 values would be wrong. Convert them (divide by log(2)) and pass the column as `logfc.col`.

Examples

de <- data.frame(
    logFC = c(2.1, -1.4, 0.2), logCPM = c(5, 7, 3),
    PValue = c(1e-8, 1e-4, 0.6), FDR = c(3e-8, 2e-4, 0.6),
    row.names = c("Cd3e", "Ms4a1", "Actb")
)
standardize_de(de)
#> Detected edgeR results (logFC, PValue, FDR)
#>   feature logfc pvalue  padj mean_expr
#> 1    Cd3e   2.1  1e-08 3e-08         5
#> 2   Ms4a1  -1.4  1e-04 2e-04         7
#> 3    Actb   0.2  6e-01 6e-01         3
standardize_de(list("KO vs WT" = de, "Het vs WT" = de))
#> Detected edgeR results in 'KO vs WT' (logFC, PValue, FDR)
#> Detected edgeR results in 'Het vs WT' (logFC, PValue, FDR)
#>   feature logfc pvalue  padj mean_expr comparison
#> 1    Cd3e   2.1  1e-08 3e-08         5   KO vs WT
#> 2   Ms4a1  -1.4  1e-04 2e-04         7   KO vs WT
#> 3    Actb   0.2  6e-01 6e-01         3   KO vs WT
#> 4    Cd3e   2.1  1e-08 3e-08         5  Het vs WT
#> 5   Ms4a1  -1.4  1e-04 2e-04         7  Het vs WT
#> 6    Actb   0.2  6e-01 6e-01         3  Het vs WT
